dedupe_keys.name: vehicle smart grid allocation using multi agent systems sensitive to irrational behavior and unstable power supply

description: The implemented multi-agent model allocates electric vehicles to charging stations using home/base, destination and battery information. It simulates irrational station preferences and individually perceived experience alongside variable electricity supply. A topology-extraction engine builds parameterized urban scenarios from real-world geographic information; the project catalogue identifies OpenStreetMap as used input. The source reports no uncharged vehicles in its simulated settings. That result is not generalized to every charging network or interpreted as verified field reliability. Exact code and implementation language remain unknown. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with restricted document or data access and licence label not stated. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
